Both inline comments are valid: the overview exceeds the README scope set in `AGENTS.md`, and it contains two grammar errors. I’ll remove those sections, which addresses both comments while preserving the setup instructions and documentation links. [GitHub’s guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-readmes) allows flexible README content; this repository sets a narrower scope.

The separate docstring warning is a generic bot recommendation, with no matching requirement in the repository guidance.
